    MindMap charts

    • charts.list List charts

    charts.list read

    GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts MCP charts_list

    List charts

    The org charts in an environment, with node and edge counts. active marks the chart open in the app.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    limitintegerPage size (1-200, default 50).
    cursorstringnextCursor from the previous page.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200,
      "default": 50,
      "description": "Page size (1-200, default 50)."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "nextCursor from the previous page."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    Output

    FieldTypeDescription
    itemsobject[]required
    items[].idstringrequired
    items[].namestringrequired
    items[].activebooleanrequired
    items[].nodesintegerrequired
    items[].edgesintegerrequired
    nextCursorstring | nullrequired
    revintegerrequiredWorkspace revision after (or at) this call.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "items": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "name": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "active": {
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "nodes": {
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "edges": {
            "type": "integer"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "id",
          "name",
          "active",
          "nodes",
          "edges"
        ]
      }
    },
    "nextCursor": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "rev": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Workspace revision after (or at) this call."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "items",
    "nextCursor",
    "rev"
  ]
}

    Example: Charts

    curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/charts" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
    {
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "c1",
      "name": "Flygon · brainstorm",
      "active": true,
      "nodes": 7,
      "edges": 7
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null,
  "rev": 42
}
